limitations: Research model, not production engine code.
No actual JS/C++/WASM crossing, GPU timing, mobile or host performance measurement.
No fonts/skeleton animation, complete EUI layout or old-project migration acceptance.
Graphics-state snapshots do not recover missing reliable events; acknowledged outbox and consumption watermarks are not implemented.
Batch flattening plus the same painter verifies command ordering, not shared per-batch state.
Resource completion is a combined load/upload callback; separate CPU decode and asynchronous GPU rebuild are not implemented.
